basics.name: Micah Tossey
basics.label: Data Analyst & Software Developer
basics.summary: I am a Computer Science graduate of the University of Hawaii at Manoa (B.S., December 2025) and currently work as an IT Support Engineer at Kukui IT in Honolulu. I enjoy turning messy data into clear answers: my project MainStats uses Python and SQL to collect, store, and analyze over 12,000 records, with a website for exploring the results. I am looking for opportunities in data analysis and software development. Outside of work I make games for game jams and hold a B.A. in Japanese.
